fullText:
From: Dana Director. Date: September 15, 2026. Subject: Concentration caps on critical battery cells.

Single-country and single-vendor concentration on critical battery cells must stay capped: no more than 60% of trailing-12-month critical cell volume from one country of origin, no more than 50% from one vendor. The caps apply at vendor award including the prospective lot. Exceptions need Finance approval and stay logged.

Our battery buying has concentrated with a small set of vendors and origins. These caps keep every award inside a balanced book: the country share and the vendor share are each measured with the prospective lot included, so an award that would breach either cap is held for Finance review instead of placing automatically.

statements.interpretation: Cap the awarded-vendor share of critical battery volume at 0.50 over the trailing 12 months
